findings.title: View mutates state without synchronization
findings.message: View mutates the Sheet (epoch/identity) and is not safe if View is invoked from a different goroutine or called multiple times per frame. More importantly, closures capture s and compare to epoch; a View call while closed resets epoch, so a click queued on an old node after reopen is correctly rejected, but any View called between Open=true and the user's activation of the earlier-rendered node keeps the same epoch, fine. The mutation in a view function is a hidden side effect that can race with owner callbacks.
findings.suggestion: Document that View must run on the owner goroutine, or guard the state with a mutex.

findings.title: Validation accepts disabled default button
findings.message: The default action is enabled-checked only by Activate != nil, but the confirm Button may be Disabled (Confirm nil or ConfirmDisabled). Validation passes. Runtime checks controlDisabled, so Return silently does nothing; acceptable, but a nil-Confirm sheet reports valid with a permanently disabled default. Also the walk does not reject Disabled default targets.
findings.suggestion: Also require !c.Disabled in the walk, or document that disabled defaults are inert.
